title: Learning to Diagnose and Correct Moral Errors: Towards Enhancing Moral Sensitivity in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses using the BBQ benchmark by treating biased answers as moral errors, prompting a judge model (DeepSeek) to determine if the revised responses remain biased, and measuring the accuracy.
